toc.text: The two certifications at a glance
Revenue Cloud Consultant blueprint and weights
Practice strategy with the exercise bank
Exam day tactics for both exams

html:
The two credentials that matter for quote-to-cash careers are Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Certified Revenue Cloud Consultant. The first tests the legacy managed-package CPQ; the second tests the modern Revenue Cloud / RLM platform, and both appear on the exam. This guide gives you the hard facts (question counts, time, passing scores, pricing), both blueprints with domain weights, a four-week study plan for each credential, and a practice strategy built around the exercise bank and Training_Question__c data model in this academy.

Learning objectives

  • Recall the exam mechanics for both credentials: length, questions, pass score, cost, and retake policy.
  • Memorize the CPQ Specialist blueprint domains and their relative weights.
  • Memorize the Revenue Cloud Consultant blueprint domains and weights.
  • Decide which certification to attempt first, and in which order.
  • Follow a 4-week study plan for each credential, paced by domain weight.
  • Use the Training_Question__c model and the exercise bank to build objective practice sets.
  • Apply test-taking tactics calibrated to each exam's scoring rules.

The two certifications at a glance

FactCPQ SpecialistRevenue Cloud Consultant
Questions60 scored (+ up to 5 unscored)60 scored (+ up to 5 unscored)
Duration105 minutes105 minutes
Passing score65%62%
CostUSD 200 (retake USD 100)USD 200 (retake USD 100)
PrerequisiteNone (Administrator experience recommended)None (2-3 years product-to-cash experience recommended)
Tested engineLegacy CPQ managed package (SBQQ__)Revenue Cloud / RLM core objects
Tip: Both exams include unscored pretest questions (up to 5) that do not count. Do not panic-count your answers during the exam; answer every question like it is scored.

CPQ Specialist blueprint and weights

The CPQ Specialist is a legacy-package exam: products, bundles, pricing, and contracts all live in the SBQQ__ world. Weights map directly to study time:

DomainWeightWhat it covers
CPQ Platform23%Architecture, security, CPQ settings, customizations, admin tasks
Bundle Configurations17%Product rules, option constraints, configuration UI, validation
Pricing16%Price rules, discount schedules, block/volume pricing, price book setup
Orders, Contracts, Amendments, Renewals15%Order generation, contract records, amendments, renewal terms
Products11%Product setup, features, options, families, asset lifecycle
Quote Templates7%Template setup, layout, custom fields, multi-language templates
Product Selection7%Product discovery, search, recommended/related product lists
Approvals4%Approval processes, chains, parallel approvals, discount routing

Study CPQ Platform + Bundle Configurations + Pricing first: together they are 56% of the exam.

Revenue Cloud Consultant blueprint and weights

The Revenue Cloud Consultant covers the modern Revenue Cloud product line including RLM. Its domain mix:

DomainWeightWhat it covers
Revenue Cloud Platform Concepts18%Architecture, unification, the modern object model, licensing
Configure Price Quote (CPQ)18%CPQ behavior on core/legacy objects, quote lifecycle, pricing
Catalog Management16%ProductCatalog, ProductCategory, products, specs, selling models
Asset Management16%Subscription lifecycle, amendments, usage, entitlements
Implementation Readiness14%Discovery, org strategy, data migration, Change Management
Contracts and Orders11%Contracting, order/transaction generation, fulfilment
Invoice Management7%Invoicing, billing schedules, relationships to revenue

Study Platform Concepts + CPQ + Catalog Management + Asset Management first: they are 68% of the exam.

Which certification first?

Take the CPQ Specialist first if you will work on existing SBQQ__ orgs; it is the classic admin path and its concepts transfer. Take the Revenue Cloud Consultant first if your org is greenfield Revenue Cloud / RLM; the consultant exam rewards 2-3 years of product-to-cash experience and its platform-concepts domain anchors the RLM data model from guide 11. Many learners do Specialist first, then Consultant, because the legacy engine is still the installed base for most enterprises.

Warning: Do not skip the legacy engine for the specialist exam because "RLM is the future." The exam blueprint (23% CPQ Platform, SBQQ product rules, SBQQ price books) and most production orgs still live in the package world.

Practice strategy with the exercise bank

The Training_Question__c custom object models a question bank: Question_Text__c, Answer_Option_A__c .. E__c, Correct_Answer__c, Explanation__c, Exam_Domain__c, Blueprint_Weight__c, Certification_Target__c, Difficulty__c, Is_Active__c. Use it like an exam engine:

soql
SELECT Id, Question_Text__c, Answer_Option_A__c, Answer_Option_B__c,
       Answer_Option_C__c, Answer_Option_D__c, Explanation__c,
       Exam_Domain__c, Difficulty__c
FROM Training_Question__c
WHERE Certification_Target__c = 'Revenue Cloud Consultant'
  AND Is_Active__c = true
  AND Difficulty__c IN ('Medium', 'Hard')
  AND Exam_Domain__c IN ('Catalog Management', 'Asset Management')
ORDER BY Blueprint_Weight__c DESC
LIMIT 20

Protocol that works:

  1. Timed sets: 20 questions in 30 minutes (scaled: the real exam is 60 in 105).
  2. Domain-weighted sets: pick questions proportionally to blueprint weights.
  3. Explain-before-reveal: answer, then reveal Explanation__c, and restate the concept in your own words.
  4. Wrong-answer journal: log Exam_Domain__c + missed concept; re-drill that domain until the journal is empty.

The practical exercises reinforce the same domains hands-on: 14.2 (Catalog & Bundle), 14.3 (Pricing & Discount), 14.4 (Approvals & Renewals), 14.5 (Billing & Revenue) map one-to-one onto blueprint domains.

Exam day tactics for both exams

  • Budget ~1.5 minutes per question. Bookmark anything you do not know instantly; return after the first pass.
  • Answer every question. There is no penalty for wrong answers; a guess is a free chance at the 65% (Specialist) or 62% (Consultant) threshold.
  • Recall the weights. If you must triage, spend remaining time on high-weight domains (CPQ Platform, Bundle Config, Pricing for Specialist; Platform Concepts, CPQ, Catalog, Asset for Consultant).
  • Watch the legacy-vs-modern trap. A question phrased with SBQQ__Quote__c is legacy CPQ; one phrased with ProductCatalog / Subscription is modern. The consultants rewrite is not interchangeable.
  • Eliminate distractors. Standard CPQ scenario sequence: validate configuration, then pricing, then approvals, then orders.
text
Scenario checksheet for every scenario question:
1. Which engine? (legacy SBQQ__ vs modern RLM core objects)
2. Which stage? (configure -> price -> approve -> contract -> order -> fulfill -> bill -> recognize)
3. What is the constraint? (option required, price ceiling, discount threshold)
4. What is the correct next automated step? (service, flow, approval, event)

Hands-on walkthrough

This mirrors exercises 14.1 (Build a Domain-Weighted Study Plan) and the practice-question exercises 14.2-14.5.

  1. Load the CPQ Specialist blueprint table (8 domains with weights) from this guide into a spreadsheet or the Training_Question__c bank.
  2. Set your total study budget (recommended 40 hours over 4 weeks).
  3. Allocate hours proportional to weight: CPQ Platform (23%) gets 23% of your hours, Approvals (4%) gets 4%.
  4. Create a study set for your top 3 weighted domains from the questions bank:
soql
SELECT Id, Question_Text__c, Exam_Domain__c, Difficulty__c,
       Explanation__c
FROM Training_Question__c
WHERE Certification_Target__c = 'CPQ Specialist'
  AND Exam_Domain__c IN ('CPQ Platform', 'Bundle Configurations', 'Pricing')
  AND Is_Active__c = true
ORDER BY Blueprint_Weight__c DESC, Difficulty__c DESC
LIMIT 25
  1. Attempt the set timed (25 questions / 35 minutes) on paper first.
  2. Reveal Correct_Answer__c and Explanation__c; mark each Exam_Domain__c hit/miss.
  3. Log misses by domain; compute your weighted readiness score = (questions right in domain x domain weight) summed across domains.
  4. Rebuild the same set filtered to your lowest-score domains and re-drill; verify the score clears 80%.
  5. Repeat the identical flow for the Revenue Cloud Consultant blueprint (Platform Concepts, CPQ, Catalog, Asset domains first).
  6. Mix engines on purpose: alternate a legacy SBQQ__ question with an RLM Subscription question to train the engine switch. Confirm your practice mix mirrors the 18% CPQ + 18% Platform split on the consultant exam.
apex
// Weighted readiness calculator (conceptual)
public static Decimal readinessScore(Map<String, Decimal> weights,
                                    Map<String, Integer> correctByDomain,
                                    Map<String, Integer> askedByDomain) {
    Decimal score = 0;
    for (String domain : weights.keySet()) {
        Integer asked = askedByDomain.get(domain) == null ? 0 : askedByDomain.get(domain);
        if (asked == 0) continue;
        Decimal hitRate = correctByDomain.get(domain) / asked;
        score += hitRate * weights.get(domain);
    }
    return score; // 0..1 readiness
}

Common pitfalls

  • Studying blueprint weights in order A-Z instead of by weight; the 4% Approval domain gets the same time as the 23% Platform domain.
  • Practicing only Training_Question__c easy questions; the real exam mixes difficulty.
  • Mixing the two engines in answers: SBQQ__ vs ProductCatalog answers are not interchangeable.
  • Underestimating the consultant's Implementation Readiness (14%) and Contracts/Orders (11%) domains because they are "soft" - they carry real questions.
  • Skipping content practice (exercises 14.2-14.5) and only reading; recognition memory beats recall under time pressure.
  • Not timing practice sets, then discovering at the exam that 105 minutes for 60 questions feels short.
  • Bookmarking and not returning: always complete the second pass before submitting.

Key takeaways

  • CPQ Specialist: 60 scored + up to 5 unscored, 105 min, 65% pass, USD 200; the big 4 domains are Platform (23%), Bundles (17%), Pricing (16%), Orders/Contracts (15%).
  • Revenue Cloud Consultant: 60 scored + up to 5 unscored, 105 min, 62% pass; Platform Concepts (18%), CPQ (18%), Catalog (16%), Asset (16%) dominate.
  • Weights are not trivia: they are the study-time allocation function.
  • Both engines are tested; train the SBQQ__ vs modern-Subscription switch deliberately.
  • Build practice sets from Training_Question__c filtered by Certification_Target__c and weighted by Blueprint_Weight__c.
  • A 4-week, weight-priced plan clears both exams; start with either cert, but not both in the same month.
